title: SAP LeanIX
description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
   

  

**Your Role**
* Configure and customize SAP LeanIX Fact Sheets, fields, and Meta Models.
* Design and develop GraphQL and REST API integrations with enterprise systems.
* Implement data governance, validation, and data quality processes within LeanIX.
* Build and maintain dashboards, surveys, and reports for Enterprise Architecture insights.
* Automate data workflows, bulk operations, and integration processes to improve efficiency.


**Your Profile**
* 3\+ years of development experience, including 2\+ years of hands\-on SAP LeanIX experience.
* Strong knowledge of LeanIX Fact Sheets, Meta Models, custom fields, GraphQL APIs, surveys, and reporting.
* Hands\-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, OAuth2/Azure AD, JSON, and data modeling.
* Good understanding of Enterprise Architecture, IT landscape modeling, and LeanIX governance practices.
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills, with a focus on data quality and automatiom.


 Capgemini is an AI\-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. **Job Description \& Summary**
 A career within Data and Analytics services will provide you with the opportunity to help organisations uncover enterprise insights and drive business results using smarter data analytics. We focus on a collection of organisational technology capabilities, including business intelligence, data management, and data assurance that help our clients drive innovation, growth, and change within their organisations in order to keep up with the changing nature of customers and technology. We make impactful decisions by mixing mind and machine to leverage data, understand and navigate risk, and help our clients gain a competitive edge.
   

  

 Creating business intelligence from data requires an understanding of the business, the data, and the technology used to store and analyse that data. Using our Rapid Business Intelligence Solutions, data visualisation and integrated reporting dashboards, we can deliver agile, highly interactive reporting and analytics that help our clients to more effectively run their business and understand what business questions can be answered and how to unlock the answers.
   

  

  

 Exp\- 4\-7yrs
   

 Location\- PAN India 
   

  

 1\.) Designing and implementing data models and schemas to support reporting and analysis in Power BI.
   

 2\.) Creating and maintaining dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Power BI.
   

 3\.) Developing and maintaining ETL pipelines to extract data from various sources, transform it into a usable format, and load it into a data warehouse or other storage systems.
   

 4\.) Collaborating with stakeholders to identify data needs and requirements, and working with data
   

 analysts to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
   

 5\.) Ideal candidates for this role should have experience with MSBI tools and technologies such as SSIS, SSAS as well as knowledge of SQL, data modeling, and database design.
   

 6\.) Optimizing ETL processes and data storage systems for performance and scalability.
   

 7\.) Providing technical support and troubleshooting for ETL and Power BI\-related issues.
